runtimeRules: Supervisor events select state; animation completion never changes backend state.
Ready for review is distinct from accepted.
Approval and question overlays are independent of working activity.
Disconnection freezes the last reliable frame.
Use real UI text for names, task titles, queue counts, and commands.
limitations: AI-generated pose sequences retain some frame-to-frame shape and shading variation; review at intended scale before shipping.
Architecture modules are illustrative and require placement/occlusion testing in the final renderer.
Working animations use the approved front-facing miniature view; four diagonal references are supplied, not four-direction animation sets.
